policy: All first-party untrusted structured input must be validated with Zod. Client validation improves UX; server validation is authoritative and mandatory. Framework-owned or cryptographically verified raw payloads require an explicit exemption.

exemptions.app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts: Better Auth owns and validates its request contract.
exemptions.app/api/cron/reconcile-payments/route.ts: No user-controlled structured body; request authentication is a signed cron secret.
exemptions.app/api/webhooks/[provider]/route.ts: Raw body must remain byte-identical for provider signature verification; provider adapters validate/normalize after signature verification.

client.policy: Forms that construct untrusted payloads for authClient must safeParse with a shared Zod schema before submission.
